title: Black Christmas
blurb: The 1974 film that helped invent the slasher, a 2006 remake that gives its killer a backstory, and a 2019 remake that keeps only the title and the sorority.

groups.title: The 2006 remake
groups.note: Adds a backstory for the killer running from 1970 to 2006.

groups.title: The 2019 remake
groups.note: A separate take, unconnected to the others.

note: The original never explains its killer, which is a big part of why it works. The 2006 remake explains everything. Watch the 1974 film first.
